target_customer: Small and mid-size businesses and operations teams that need to automate complex, long-running business processes without coding
problem: Business processes with approvals, forms and integrations are managed in spreadsheets, CRMs or ERPs; Workflow86 lets teams build them in a no-code platform, later with AI that designs the workflow from a description.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a 14-day free trial
product_category: no-code and AI workflow automation platform

founders.name: Aaron Tran
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder with no background. A Makerpad article titled as a self-taught coder story exists but could not be opened (404), so background is not verified.

competitors.name: Checkbox
competitors.what: Australian no-code app and workflow builder

competitors.name: Flowingly
competitors.what: Process mapping and no-code workflow automation for mid-market teams (New Zealand)

technical_complexity.rationale: A workflow engine with forms, human tasks, versioned in-flight runs and integrations is standard but substantial engineering; AI generation of workflows added later.

defensibility.rationale: Workflows built on the platform create some lock-in, but many no-code automation tools (Zapier, Checkbox, Flowingly) offered overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the company stayed independent with a small team.

market_need_then: Businesses relied on spreadsheets, CRMs and ERPs for processes (per the YC launch post); no-code workflow companies in the region raised rounds in early 2022, indicating demand.

branding.community_and_virality: A Show HN post for Workflow86 exists; one commenter said they liked the name.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence beyond directory listings and a Show HN thread.

pivots.from: no-code workflow builder for business operations
pivots.to: AI-first workflow automation where AI designs and builds the workflow
pivots.why: Not stated; the current YC page and launch post describe AI generation of workflows from natural language.

outcome_analysis: Workflow86 is Active with a team of about six based in Sydney and has kept shipping, now positioned around AI agents and human in the loop workflows. Public funding is limited to YC style small notes in aggregators, so growth, revenue and runway are unknown. A crowded no-code and AI automation market is the main constraint.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting across aggregators: CB Insights 0.5M convertible note 2022-01 with YC; Extruct 125K seed 2022-04 with YC and CyRise; FundedIQ 300K in 2021-06. Not recorded as rounds. Founder background could not be verified (Makerpad article returned 404). Technical flag set to null. Competitor figures come from the press items cited, covering other firms. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown; a September 2021 podcast mentioned a CyRise partnership (not opened). Completeness pass: one round recorded from CB Insights (convertible note, 500K USD, January 2022, Y Combinator). It rests on a single database. Extruct 125K seed April 2022 with CyRise and FundedIQ 300K June 2021 conflict and are not recorded; CyRise is unconfirmed.
